description: This file defines instrumentation and event handling for SDK objects within the Playwright core server, including classes, interfaces, and functions for managing event listeners, SDK object lifecycle, and instrumentation callbacks.

classes.name: SdkObject
classes.description: Represents an SDK object with attribution and instrumentation, capable of emitting events and managing its lifecycle.

methods.name: closeReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for closing the SDK object, checking page, context, and browser attribution.

methods.name: createRootSdkObject
methods.description: Creates a root SDK object with a fake parent, used as a starting point in the SDK object hierarchy.

methods.name: createInstrumentation
methods.description: Creates an instrumentation object that manages event listeners and dispatches instrumentation events.
